1. Pre-processing & Analysis

2. Manual Retouching

3. Automated Content-Aware Fill / Inpainting

4. Frequency-Domain (Fourier) Filtering  
   Best for repetitive, tiled watermarks or halftone patterns:

6. Workflow Tips & Forensic Best Practices
